title: WEDM On-Device Learning Infrastructure (LoRA + EWC + Few-Shot)
insertion_point: Master roadmap §5 MS-P4-DL-CORE (lines 701-745 of WEDM-CONSOLIDATED-ROADMAP.md v1.4)
philosophy: Deep Learning — every finished WEDM job feeds a learning loop. Wire-break-rate, Ra, and recast-depth predictors improve job-over-job without catastrophic forgetting. This is where the system graduates from deterministic physics to adaptive near-AGI.

engines: WEDMFewShotEngine (existing — adapt new material in ≤2 cuts, built under P3-MS2)
WEDMNeuralTrainingEngine (existing — Bayesian + GP + Klocke + Kunieda + Weibull)
PRISMLoRAAdapterEngine (existing — LoRA inventory/registry, not the math)
FisherInformationEngine (existing — generic info-theory: entropy, KL, JSD, MI, discrete Fisher for Bernoulli)
formulas: LoRA rank-4 adapters — Hu et al. 2021 'LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models' arXiv:2106.09685
EWC++ Fisher information — Chaudhry et al. 2018 'Riemannian Walk for Incremental Learning' ECCV
LinUCB bandit — Li et al. 2010 (existing WEDM_RL_POLICY v1 state snapshot)
tribal: new substrate — no tribal tips apply until jobs recorded
reference: WEDM_JOB_HISTORY.json schema v1 (to be created in U-P4-DL-01)

session_split.focus: Job outcome + LoRA + EWC; /compact after U-P4-DL-03

0.title: WEDMJobOutcomeEngine — capture finished-job telemetry into WEDM_JOB_HISTORY.json schema v1
abort_conditions: Zod schema rejects a canonical recorded job
BASELINE_INVENTORY WEDM engine count not bumped by +1
exit_criteria: 10 synthetic jobs record+replay bit-exact via the engine
dispatcher action prism_edm:wedm_learn_from_job surfaces + routes to engine
WEDMJobOutcomeEngine.test.ts has ≥ 10 cases incl. zero/negative/extreme cycle times (no bare .toBeGreaterThan(0) / .toBeLessThan(1000))
0.scope_note: 2026-04-21 audit: engine does NOT exist under this exact name. WEDMContinuousLearningEngine is the closest existing substrate — it orchestrates 4 feedback signals (Ra, cycle time, wire-break, operator) but does NOT capture into a canonical WEDM_JOB_HISTORY.json file under schema v1. Option (build-new): construct WEDMJobOutcomeEngine that consumes WEDMContinuousLearningEngine output and persists to canonical schema. Option (rename+extend): rename WEDMContinuousLearningEngine → WEDMJobOutcomeEngine with schema v1 persistence added. Build-new preferred per web/CLAUDE.md rule 'never rename existing Codex/Claude engines without deprecation shim'.

1.title: WEDMLoRAAdapterEngine — rank-4 low-rank adapters on top of Klocke / DiBitonto base models
abort_conditions: forward-pass output deviates > 1% from Hu 2021 §4.1 reference vector
rank ≠ 4 (must be exactly rank-4 per envelope)
exit_criteria: backward-pass gradient matches autodiff numerical check ±0.5%
Klocke base output unchanged when adapter scale = 0 (identity invariant)
1.scope_note: 2026-04-21 audit: PRISMLoRAAdapterEngine exists but is an INVENTORY/REGISTRY engine (manages adapter files on disk), NOT a low-rank math implementation. The math engine does NOT exist. WEDM_LORA_CHECKPOINT.json exists (772 bytes) from earlier P3 work but WEDM_LORA_WEIGHTS.json does not. Distinction: PRISMLoRAAdapterEngine.register(id, path) vs WEDMLoRAAdapterEngine.forward(input, adapterWeights) — different concerns, both needed. Build-new required.

2.title: WEDMEWCMemoryEngine — EWC++ with Fisher-information penalty (Chaudhry 2018)
abort_conditions: Fisher-info diagonal not computed per Chaudhry 2018 §3.2
λ schedule fabricated (not cited to Chaudhry 2018 Table 1 or equivalent published source)
exit_criteria: λ schedule matches Chaudhry 2018 Table 1 (or equivalent cited published source)
after 3 material batches, old-material MAE regresses ≤ 10% (catastrophic-forgetting test)
2.scope_note: 2026-04-21 audit: FisherInformationEngine exists (generic info-theory: Shannon, KL, JSD, MI, discrete Bernoulli Fisher — built for AGI-safety/active-learning, NOT EWC++ specifically). Reusable as dependency: WEDMEWCMemoryEngine can consume FisherInformationEngine for the diagonal. The WEDM-specific EWC orchestration (λ schedule, old-task memory, penalty integration with training loop) must still be built.

3.title: WEDMFewShotMaterialEngine — given 3-5 successful jobs in new material, bootstrap an adapter
abort_conditions: MAE on nearby thickness > base-model MAE on same thickness (bootstrap degrades performance)
exit_criteria: 3-job bootstrap on D2 improves Ra MAE by ≥ 20% vs base
dispatcher wiring green (engine surfaces via prism_edm)
3.scope_note: 2026-04-21 audit: WEDMFewShotEngine exists (built under P3-MS2/U-P3-07 — 'adapt unknown material in ≤2 cuts' via spark-signature DB + near-neighbor recipe transfer). It implements a DIFFERENT algorithm than the envelope's 'bootstrap an adapter from 3-5 successful jobs' (which needs to plug into the LoRA adapter from U-P4-DL-02). Resolution: EXTEND the existing engine with a bootstrap-from-job-history mode that consumes WEDM_JOB_HISTORY.json (U-P4-DL-01) and produces LoRA adapter weights (U-P4-DL-02) — layer on top of the existing 2-cut protocol, don't replace it. Rename of final unit to match reality.

4.title: Test suite — 18+ tests covering LoRA math, EWC gradient, few-shot bootstrap, forgetting regression
abort_conditions: any test uses .toBeGreaterThan(0), .toBeLessThan(1000), or bare .includes() — banned-pattern-block hook will reject
exit_criteria: all MAE bounds use .toBeCloseTo(published, N) form with a named reference
4.scope_note: Depends on U-P4-DL-02 (LoRA), U-P4-DL-03 (EWC), U-P4-DL-04 (FewShot extension). Cannot run before those exist. Sequencing: U-01 → U-02 → U-03 → U-04 → U-05.
